text: {"lessons":["My account value fell 4.8% in one period, so I should keep risk modest and avoid letting any one stock dominate my savings.","Selling Stock D at a large loss did not prevent later account values from recovering; I should base future decisions on the outlook and my plan, not just my purchase price or the urge to recover losses.","I traded little, and my account value rose in the following periods; I should avoid unnecessary trading and review my holdings calmly each month."]}
